title: Shared diagnostics apply only the engine-token redactor
description: The diagnostic export copies engine log generations into Documents and applies EngineAuth.redact. Daily log copies use additional credential-shaped and private-key redaction. Source does not establish that engine logs contain those other secret forms or who can read the particular export.
claimed_root_cause: The shared diagnostic log mirror applies only EngineAuth.redact, so credential formats handled by LogSanitizer may remain if they occur in engine output.

trace.description: Failure diagnostics are copied into a shared Documents directory when writable.
The copied log text is transformed only by EngineAuth.redact before writing.

evidence.description: The shared diagnostic copy is documented as readable by apps with all-files access and contains engine logs.
mirrorLogBounded applies EngineAuth.redact to the copied text.
The separate LogSanitizer handles multiple secret classes for daily log output.

blockers: No reviewed source or runtime log proves that the engine emits a credential shape that EngineAuth.redact misses.
The identity and storage permissions of an actual reader of a diagnostic copy are not established in this source-only review.
The required OS-enforced sandbox and Android device are unavailable, so no synthetic log export or cross-app read check was performed.

validation_plan.local: With an approved OS-enforced sandbox, call the bounded mirror helper on a synthetic engine log containing only dummy private-key and provider-key markers. Inspect the copied output and verify each marker is redacted or remains; do not use real credentials.
validation_plan.deployment: Have the owner inspect only synthetic diagnostic output on a test installation and report the Android storage policy and whether an ordinary app or an authorized all-files-access test app can read the copy. Do not inspect real logs or credentials.
